Aventon Abound LR
Long-Tail Cargo Ebike

 

The Aventon Abound LR is built to replace car trips. A 750W rear hub motor (1,188W peak), extended long-tail rear rack rated to 143 lbs, and 440 lb total capacity give you the platform to carry kids, groceries, gear, or anything else your day demands - confidently and comfortably. The gravity cast 6061 aluminum step-through frame, adjustable quill stem, 51mm travel suspension fork, and 50mm travel suspension seatpost keep the ride comfortable regardless of load, and the low-slung 20" wheels keep the center of gravity where it belongs. Integrated turn signals and front and rear lights are built in throughout. The Abound LR ships as Class 2 with throttle included and fits riders from 4'11" to 6'3". Available by special order at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL.

The ACU connected platform brings 4G/GPS tracking, an integrated rear wheel e-lock, startup password protection, integrated kickstand lock, motion detection and alarm, geofencing, remote shutdown, and over-the-air firmware updates - all managed through the Aventon MyRide app. Sensor Switch lets you toggle between torque and cadence sensing. Boost Mode delivers up to 120% of peak torque for 30 seconds for heavy starts or steep climbs. Cruise Control, Ride Tune customization, and Hold Mode round out the feature set. The cross-model keyless battery is compatible with the Abound SR, Aventure 3, Level 3, and Pace 4. Note: 4G connectivity is complimentary for the first year; a paid subscription is required after that period.

E-Bikes are subject to a $160 assembly & tuning fee

The Abound LR is a special order item at Quest Watersports - we don't stock it on the floor, but we can get one for you. Lead time is typically 1-2 weeks subject to Aventon's inventory. Let us order one for you today - call 815.433.2200 or email contact@questwatersports.com.

Included with every Abound LR:

  • Rear rack (143 lb weight limit)
  • Full fenders, front and rear
  • Frame storage bag
  • Throttle (left handlebar mounted)
  • Integrated front and rear lights with turn signals
  • Suspension seatpost (50mm travel)
  • Aventon saddle with passenger grab handle
  • 9/16" composite platform pedals
  • 42V 4A charger
 

Optional passenger and cargo accessories available separately - child carrier kit, passenger chair, rear rack basket, handrail, rear handlebar, and more.
